visual.general_description: Two stacked panels (A, B), each a grayscale transoesophageal sector image beside the same view with a colour-flow overlay.
visual.detailed_description: Whole figure is a tall image with panel A on top and panel B below, each divided into a grayscale left half and a colour-flow right half. Both panels carry scanner text, a temperature readout, a heart-rate readout of 136 bpm, an ECG trace and a velocity colour bar. Panel A shows a patchy blue and yellow colour pattern; panel B shows broader yellow and orange-brown colour areas.

panels.general_description: Top panel: side-by-side grayscale and colour-flow transoesophageal sector images in the first phase shown.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A (upper half) shows two sector-shaped images side by side. The left image is grayscale with bright linear and curved echoes in the upper central region and bright masses along the left and lower edges, with large dark areas between them. The right image repeats the same grayscale view with a white-outlined colour sector over the central region; inside the sector there is a mosaic of blue, yellow and orange-brown pixels, with a yellow band along the upper part and a patchy blue and yellow pattern below. Printed on each panel: top-left scanner settings text (2D 59%, C 50, P Off, Gen, CF 48%, 7104Hz, WF 639Hz, 4.4MHz), a small half-circle angle indicator reading 0 and 180 with the pointer at 0, "PAT T: 37.0C" and "TEE T: 39.3C" at lower left, a green ECG trace at the bottom edge, a velocity colour bar with the printed label "-61.6" and "cm/s" on the right of the colour image, and "136 bpm" at lower right. The label A is at upper left, and the printed ECG trace at the bottom edge is short with one downward deflection at its left end.
